title: Dominant-Domain Linear/Nonlinear Binding
claim: Linear and nonlinear aspects may function as primitives only within their declared dominant domains.

<*>_x.reading: typed meta-relation coupling L and NL under declared context x

governance_rule: Any use of RT := [L <*>_x NL] must declare the domain in which L and NL are dominant-domain primitives and must not supersede RT_core := [(ℰ≠0) ⇔R δα(ℰ>0)].

governance_position.rule: This induction is clarification-only at the induction layer.
governance_position.non_promotion_clause: It may not be used to promote theorems, close proof dependencies, or claim a settled ontology.
forbidden_readings: L and NL are global primitives outside a declared dominant domain

fit_assessment.reason: The principle preserves canonical RT_core precedence while constraining linear and nonlinear primitivity to an explicitly declared dominant domain.

required_followup.textbook_patch: Apply Chapter 1.2A and Appendix F clarifications as provisional only.
